stdout: Verified: DataLoader wrote to _FILE_CACHE even when cache=False; vars_files passed False, so vaulted files were repeatedly decrypted. Loader now supports none (no cache reads or writes) and vaulted (cache only decrypted vault files) while retaining boolean caller behavior. vars_files now requests vaulted caching. Added unit tests for both modes and a real vaulted file. Local parsing and variable manager tests: 43 passed. git diff --check passed.

+        self.assertEqual(len(self._loader._FILE_CACHE), 1)
+

+
+        self._loader.load_from_file('vars.yml', cache='vaulted')
+        self.assertEqual(self._loader.load_from_file('vars.yml', cache='none'), {'foo': 'fresh'})
+        self.assertEqual(mock_contents.call_count, 2)
+
